brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Current build: only piece:0,0,0;full (counts piece:1). No spike, no drawer/notch-drawer. Tested geometries: single cell offers no spike/drawer sockets; 2-cell cluster (0,0+1,0) offers notch sockets at 0,1(k1) and 1,-1(k4) but no spike; 3-cell triangular cluster (0,0+1,0+0,1) offers spike at junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 (s8/s123/s161) and notch sockets at -1,1(k0),1,-1(k4),1,1(k2) – none overlapping same corner of same cell. Placed notch hex-drawer-frame-notch-mf at 1,1 and spike at 0,0|0,1|1,0 still separated to different junctions, not touching. Configurator offers no coincident drawer+spike placement at one corner, so requirement cannot be met with available sockets. meshClash=clear, only OPEN_CAP_FACE info.

finish.summary: Build reset to single full base. Requirement for drawer and spike at identical corner touching is unmet: socket queries prove spike needs 3 mutually-adjacent cells while notch-drawer needs empty cell beside two touching bases, and even the minimal 3-cell triangle yields disjoint sockets (spike at 0,0|0,1|1,0 vs notches at peripheral cells), with zero drawer sockets and no overlapping offer. check_build clear.
